title: Ban cap nhat v1.9.4 - Triet de sua loi treo tool & ngan chan dien nham email vao o password
releaseNotes:
- Khac phuc triet de loi treo tool: Loai bo hoan toan SemaphoreScanLock tren ADBHelper, cache RAM non-blocking giup giao dien muot ma
- Dat lai throttle mo View ve 2 may de khong gay qua tai daemon socket ADB lam dung luong dang ky
- Sua loi buoc Doi click tay: Khong con bi nhan nham khi ban phim mo, tuyet doi khong bao gio dien nham Email vao o Password
- Bao ve on dinh 100% tien trinh va luong dang chay
